items.title: Former governor-general Peter Hollingworth dies aged 91
items.description: Peter Hollingworth was the first and only cleric to serve as governor-general, before his resignation in 2003 amid his handling of historical church abuse scandals.

items.title: Man accused of killing wife and two children in Sydney home fronts court
items.description: The 47-year-old has faced court charged with what police describe as the "particularly violent" murder of his wife and sons in Sydney's south-west.

items.title: Planned upgrades to ageing submarine fleet scaled back
items.description: A massive program of upgrades to Australia's aging fleet of Collins Class submarines, aimed at keeping them in the water a decade longer, is being scaled back.

items.title: RBA warns Australia risks slipping into '1990s recession' as oil shock mounts
items.description: The Reserve Bank is growing increasingly anxious about price pressures building in the economy and its chief economist has raised the risk of a recession in post-budget remarks.

items.title: Apology for 'appalling' display of autopsy body parts without consent
items.description: A formal apology is given in Tasmania's parliament for the past practice of taking human specimens from autopsies and displaying them in a museum without the knowledge of family members.

items.title: Top BOM exec who led bungled $96M website revamp departs role
items.description: Peter Stone was acting CEO when the BOM launched its new website, which was widely criticised for its costs and poor design.

items.title: Ex-GP charged with 148 counts of rape and sexual assault
items.description: A former Brisbane doctor has been charged with 148 counts of rape and sexual assault following an extensive police investigation.

items.title: Two Italian divers' bodies recovered from underwater cave
items.description: Finnish divers recovered the bodies after they were located deep inside an underwater cave in the Maldives.

items.title: Xi to welcome Putin for visit days after hosting Trump
items.description: While this meeting comes just days after Beijing hosted the US president, the Kremlin insists there is "no correlation" between the visits.

items.title: Undersea volcanic eruption visible from space
items.description: The Titan Ridge Volcano is erupting in the Bismarck Sea, sending ash and smoke into the sky and prompting authorities to warn of possible tsunamis in the area.

items.title: ARIA winner TISM causes $18,000 in damage to Sydney Opera House
items.description: The anarchic, ARIA-winning group has been hit with a hefty fine by the Sydney Opera House before its first national tour in more than 30 years.

items.title: Rain 'more than double' forecast drenches Gold Coast amid BOM accuracy concerns
items.description: As flash flooding from record-setting rainfall recedes, some south-east Queensland residents feel that Bureau of Meteorology forecasts fell short of what was experienced.

items.title: 'Silence is not consent': Mother raped by massage therapist
items.description: A Queensland massage therapist has been imprisoned for raping a client who says "silence is not consent" and that the "degrading" experience devastated her emotionally, physically and financially.

items.title: Aussie great-grandmother to compete at Comm Games
items.description: At 75 years old, Jacky Hudson will tread an unlikely path for a great-grandmother after earning selection in Australia's Commonwealth Games lawn bowls squad.

items.title: 'Nowhere for me to exist': Growing up as a biracial child
items.description: KA was "stripped" of her culture as a child and has been on a journey to reclaim her connection to her Filipina heritage.

items.title: What Kylie Minogue learned from Michael Hutchence and Nick Cave
items.description: Australia's reigning Queen of Pop discusses her relationships with Nick Cave and the late Michael Hutchence, and being tapped to headline the AFL grand final's pre-game entertainment.

items.title: Money stress causing tension in your relationship? This might help
items.description: While financial tension between partners isn't always about money, many people clash over values, spending habits and how they respond to financial pressure.

items.title: Death penalty rates at 40-year high globally, Amnesty International says
items.description: A crackdown in Iran drove a surge in the number of people executed worldwide in 2025, but China remains the "leading executioner," human rights group Amnesty International says.

items.title: How planes shot down decades ago could be central to Trump's plans in Cuba
items.description: Cuban President Miguel Díaz-Canel Bermúdez says Cuba's right to defend itself should not be used by the US as justification for a potential war.

items.title: Israeli forces have detained 11 Australians after intercepting Gaza-bound flotilla
items.description: Israeli forces detain 11 Australians after its navy intercepts ships seeking to break Israel's maritime blockade of Gaza, flotilla organisers say.

items.title: Will the war in Iran make Australia use less plastic?
items.description: Could the war in Iran change the way we recycle back home? Australia mostly relies on importing plastic from overseas. As well as petrol and diesel, the Strait of Hormuz is a key delivery route for a crucial backbone of plastic production. But, that's now cut off. It's led to a growing conversation about how Australia might transition to fully recycling plastic packaging onshore.

items.title: Key takeaways from Sam Altman and Elon Musk's bitter legal battle
items.description: A legal showdown between two of the tech world's most powerful men has reached its end. Here's what we learned throughout the trial.

items.title: WHO 'deeply concerned' over Ebola outbreak after at least 131 people die
items.description: The cash-strapped World Health Organization is sending a team of experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo as hundreds of cases of Ebola are suspected.

items.title: What we know about the deadly shooting at a San Diego mosque
items.description: Two teenagers opened fire at the largest mosque in San Diego, California on Monday, killing three men. Here is what we know about the attack.

items.title: Inquest hears elderly man who died was given another person's medication
items.description: An 82-year-old South Australian man died after he ingested prescription medication that was meant for another person and had been incorrectly labelled, a coronial inquest is told.
